text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Last night's encounter in the music room— 
it was truly *dolce*.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
An unseen, shadowy pianista. An 
intoxicating four-hand duet, lost in a 
fierce yet melancholic melodia—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And then! The percussion joined in! Desks, 
chairs, and windows beating out a dynamic, 
trembling rhythm! Appassionato binds our 
souls together, and then—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Aahh! I want to meet them again! And 
have an intensely passionate session 
together! If only staying in school after 
dark wasn't forbidden...!
